newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 6.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- New methods and investment at Ivory Coast's Yabra rice project will expand the area under production to 150 hectares in 1997 from around 100 hectares last year.
- Private telephone company Publicom says newly privatised telephone company Ci-Telcom is blocking its right to set up public telephone booths.
- Students' union FESCI says its members will move into city halls, churches and mosques to protest against a government decision to close student residences.
- Exporters and others involved in the cocoa business are expressing concern over the way the sector has been liberalised since the process began in 1996.
